rules.heading: THE NAKSHTRAS IN WHICH ECLIPSES OCCUR

planetary.freeform: Nakshatra in which an eclipse occurs is rejected (6 months for full eclipse, 3 months for half eclipse, 1 month for one-fourth eclipse). Avoid 3 days before/after or specific rising/setting eclipse conditions.

rules.notes: Nakshatras afflicted by eclipses are forbidden for auspicious deeds for varying durations depending on the extent of the eclipse.

rules.heading: ORGANS OF THE PANCHANGA WHICH ARE TO BE AVOIDED IN DOING AUSPICIOUS DEEDS

planetary.freeform: Birth nakshatra, birth month, birth date, Vyatipata, Bhadra, Vaidhriti yoga, Amavasya, day of death of father and mother, and tithi that has not occurred.

rules.notes: Certain specific sensitive panchang elements like birth star, specific yogas, and dark moon tithi must be avoided for auspicious activities.
